commits.subject: Remove IVV-CSF-AIA rule from class a requirements.
Add comment for removal of IVV-CSF-AIA in FedRAMP consolidated rules.
Update FRC-CSO-PKG statement to remove certification class reference; add new vulnerability terms to VDR-TFR-PVR.
Add "related" reference in VDR-TFR-PVR to VER-EVA-EPA in FedRAMP consolidated rules.
Update metadata version and add "related" reference to VER-EVA-EPA in VDR-TFR-PVR; clarify N-rating definition in class certification requirements.
Removed CDS-CSO-AVR (Availability Reporting) since this rule is defined as SHOULD and included in FRC-CLA-RFR (Recommended FedRAMP Rules for Class A)
Update terminology from "Reporting" to "Communication" in FedRAMP Incident Evaluation rules.
